title: Encyclopaedia Britannica; or, A dictionary of arts, sciences, and miscellaneous literature - Fourth edition, Volume 8 Part 2, FAI-FOR - EB.9
text: Flanders is a perfectly champaign country, with not a riding ground or hill in it, and watered with many fine riverside and canals. Its chief commandics are find lace, lines, and tapelfry.
